name: smwmusic-the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-bring-the-heat-in-gerudo-valley-remix
title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - Bring the Heat in!! 🔥 ~ Gerudo Valley (Remix)
description:
❝ 𝙄 𝘽𝙐𝙏𝙏𝙀𝙍 𝙄𝙏 𝙐𝙋 𝙐𝙋!! 𝙄 𝘽𝙐𝙏𝙏𝙀𝙍 𝙄𝙏 𝙐𝙋 𝙐𝙋!! ❞
ㅤ- Smooth McGroove (2013)

Did a special arrangement of THE WORLD'S GREATEST ZELDA / DESERT THEME from The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. This was one of the few songs I've been holding off doing until the moment was right because I really wanted to make this remix something else. Gerudo Valley is one of my favorite songs of all-time, despite mostly hearing it in games outside of its original source material (i.e. Nintendo Land, Smash 4, Cadence of Hyrule, etc.).

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤㅤ ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤㅤ - "P-Switch" (@12) ← ("SBM2 Synth Brass.brr" is in its place in case you really need it)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX
ㅤ3. Decreased Echo Delay & Cut Intro (INTRO Cut)
ㅤㅤ ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤㅤ - "P-Switch" (@12) ← ("SBM2 Synth Brass.brr" is in its place in case you really need it)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. F# Minor w/ Slight Detune (Remix Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. F# Minor (Original Pitch)
ㅤ3. G Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ4. E Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
ㅤ5. F Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
